items.name: Zoom punch
items.summary: Outgoing rams into the lens under blur; incoming lands over-scaled and settles.
items.whenToUse: Hook-to-body cut, beat drops, the hero claim reveal; any cut that should land like a hit.
items.whenNotToUse: Calm or premium registers, talking-head continuity, more than one in every three or four cuts.

items.name: Whip pan
items.summary: Both scenes travel sideways together under a horizontal-only smear, like a fast camera pan.
items.whenToUse: Moving between two places, list items, before/after pairs; strong with B-roll that already has lateral motion.
items.whenNotToUse: Text-heavy frames the viewer must read mid-move; vertical-motion footage (use slide-push up instead).

items.name: Blur dissolve
items.summary: Outgoing defocuses while the incoming fades in from the same defocus and pulls sharp.
items.whenToUse: Time passing, mood shifts, wind-down after a climax, luxury and wellness pieces.
items.whenNotToUse: Fast hooks, comedic timing, meme edits; it reads as slow on a 15 s piece.

items.name: Mask wipe
items.summary: Incoming wipes over the outgoing through a feathered diagonal mask while the outgoing recedes.
items.whenToUse: Section changes in explainers, product feature to feature, editorial lists.
items.whenNotToUse: Chaotic footage where the soft edge gets lost; back-to-back with another wipe.

items.name: Glitch cut
items.summary: Stepped jitter, slice bars and hue hits with a two-flicker swap; deterministic via a seeded PRNG.
items.whenToUse: Tech reveals, plot twists, error or hack themes, gaming and music edits.
items.whenNotToUse: Trust-heavy content (finance, health), premium brands, more than twice per video.

items.name: Flash white
items.summary: Overexposure: the outgoing blows out, a flash plate peaks on the cut, the incoming exposes down.
items.whenToUse: Beat drops, camera-shutter moments, before/after reveals, the punchline frame.
items.whenNotToUse: Photosensitivity-risk sequences (never chain several within a second), dark moody pieces.

items.name: Luma dip
items.summary: Shadows crush first and highlights last into black, then the incoming exposes back in the same order.
items.whenToUse: Chapter breaks, tension beats, the last cut before the outro, cinematic trailers.
items.whenNotToUse: Upbeat hooks and fast lists; the black hold reads as a drop-off on short feeds.

items.name: Spin swap
items.summary: Outgoing spins away while scaling up under blur; the incoming spins in from the opposite angle.
items.whenToUse: Playful creator edits, product angle changes, music transitions on a snare.
items.whenNotToUse: Corporate or premium registers; footage with a strong horizon that makes viewers dizzy.

items.name: Slide push
items.summary: Feed-native push: the incoming shoves the outgoing out of frame on one shared curve.
items.whenToUse: Next point in a list, swipe-native storytelling, carousels turned into video.
items.whenNotToUse: Emotional peaks (too neutral), the opening cut of a hook.

items.name: Circle iris
items.summary: Incoming opens from a point through a circular clip, led by an accent ring.
items.whenToUse: Zooming into a detail (set the origin on it), playful reveals, retro and cartoon edits.
items.whenNotToUse: Serious news or B2B explainers; origins inside the platform UI zones.

items.name: Split reveal
items.summary: Incoming opens from a center seam outward, accent edges ride the opening, outgoing sinks back.
items.whenToUse: Before/after, comparisons, opening a new topic, title-to-content.
items.whenNotToUse: Two busy frames in a row (the seam gets lost); more than one per minute.

items.name: Zoom-out reveal
items.summary: Outgoing shrinks into a rounded card and flies off; the incoming behind it eases to rest.
items.whenToUse: App and UI demos, 'and that was just the start' beats, stepping back to the big picture.
items.whenNotToUse: Live-action continuity cuts; frames whose subject is at the very edge.

items.name: RGB split
items.summary: Chromatic aberration: R and B channels slide apart, the cut lands at maximum split, channels re-converge.
items.whenToUse: Music edits, gaming, tech drops, a softer alternative to glitch-cut.
items.whenNotToUse: Skin-tone close-ups held long, trust-heavy content.

items.name: Light leak
items.summary: Warm tint plate plus two oversized blooms drift across; the swap hides under peak warmth.
items.whenToUse: Lifestyle, travel, memories, wedding and family edits, nostalgic hooks.
items.whenNotToUse: Tech and clinical registers, dark horror pieces, fast meme cuts.

items.name: Shutter blinds
items.summary: Slats close top-down over the outgoing, swap fully covered, open bottom-up on the incoming.
items.whenToUse: Topic changes, data and chapter cards, structured explainers.
items.whenNotToUse: Warm or organic registers; low slat counts look like a loading bug.

items.name: Stretch squash
items.summary: CRT off/on: the outgoing collapses to a bright line, the incoming stretches back out with overshoot.
items.whenToUse: Retro, VHS and arcade edits, comedic 'and then' cuts, channel-change gags.
items.whenNotToUse: Premium brands, emotional beats.

items.name: Film burn
items.summary: Amber, orange and red blooms bleed in from one edge with a brightness spike; swap at the hottest frame.
items.whenToUse: Vintage, documentary, music-video and travel edits; scene-to-scene in a story.
items.whenNotToUse: UI demos and clean SaaS pieces; repeated use flattens it.

items.name: Block dissolve
items.summary: Large blocks in two palette colors pop in a seeded order to cover, then clear in another order.
items.whenToUse: Gaming, kids and playful brand edits, data or pixel themes.
items.whenNotToUse: Premium and cinematic registers; small block counts beyond 12 columns read as a cheap grid.

items.name: Card flip
items.summary: 3D page turn: the outgoing rotates edge-on, the incoming continues the turn from the far side.
items.whenToUse: Flipping a card or answer (question to answer), myth vs fact, product variants.
items.whenNotToUse: Live-action footage with motion (the flat card exposes it), several flips in a row.

items.name: Ink bleed
items.summary: Four feathered radial masks bloom at staggered times and merge into the incoming scene.
items.whenToUse: Art, food, beauty and handmade product edits; soft topic changes.
items.whenNotToUse: Tech and data registers, urgent hooks.

items.name: Lower third
items.summary: Accent block wipes in, the name rises out of a mask, the role slides after.
items.whenToUse: Introducing a speaker or expert, interview and podcast clips, testimonials.
items.whenNotToUse: Faceless edits with no person on screen; positions below y 1380 (TikTok UI).

items.name: Text pop
items.summary: Words pop one by one with overshoot and alternating tilt; stroke keeps them legible over footage.
items.whenToUse: Hooks in the first second, punchlines, one-to-three-word emphasis.
items.whenNotToUse: Sentences over five words; stacking with captions in the same zone.

items.name: Highlight sweep
items.summary: Marker bar sweeps behind the key phrase after the line has landed.
items.whenToUse: Explainers, key takeaways, quoting a stat or rule, educational content.
items.whenNotToUse: Highlighting more than one phrase per line; low-contrast marker colors.

items.name: Arrow callout
items.summary: Target ring pulses, a hand-drawn arrow draws toward it, the label pops at the tail.
items.whenToUse: Pointing at a UI detail, a product feature, a face in the crowd, a price tag.
items.whenNotToUse: Busy frames with several targets (one arrow per beat); targets inside the platform UI.

items.name: Counter roll
items.summary: Big tabular number counts up with a decelerating ease, then punches once on arrival.
items.whenToUse: Revenue, follower and result stats, proof beats in ads.
items.whenNotToUse: Unverified numbers; counting very small values (a 0 to 3 roll looks broken).

items.name: Progress bar
items.summary: Track slides in, the fill grows with a live percentage, a glint passes on completion.
items.whenToUse: Progress, battery, completion, survey results, 'loading the reveal' gags.
items.whenNotToUse: Several bars at once without labels; values the viewer cannot verify.

items.name: Emoji burst
items.summary: Particles burst from a point on seeded angles, arc under gravity, spin and fade.
items.whenToUse: Reactions, wins, likes and celebration beats, comedic payoffs.
items.whenNotToUse: Serious topics; emoji the platform renders differently than the render host.

items.name: Subtitle emphasis
items.summary: A caption line lands, then one word takes the hit: box, color swap and an elastic scale punch.
items.whenToUse: Talking-head captions, the key word of a hook, meme-style emphasis.
items.whenNotToUse: Emphasizing every line (it stops meaning anything); long caption lines.

items.name: CTA pulse
items.summary: Pill button springs in, a cursor taps it, a ripple expands, the button pulses twice.
items.whenToUse: End cards, follow and link-in-bio asks, app download prompts.
items.whenNotToUse: The first three seconds; more than one CTA per video.

items.name: Tag chips
items.summary: Feature chips stack in from the right with a stagger and a soft overshoot.
items.whenToUse: Feature lists, ingredients, specs, quick benefit stacks in ads.
items.whenNotToUse: More than five chips; long chip text that wraps.

items.name: Checklist tick
items.summary: Rows land, then each box draws its check in turn and the row dims to done.

params.label: Items (pipe-separated)
params.default: Script in 5 minutes | Voice in one take | Cut on the beat

items.whenToUse: Step lists, routines, requirements, 'what you get' summaries.
items.whenNotToUse: More than five rows; items longer than one line.

items.name: Underline draw
items.summary: Headline lands, then a hand-drawn stroke draws under the key word like a marker pass.
items.whenToUse: Hooks with one loaded word, contrarian claims, education.
items.whenNotToUse: Underlining a word that wraps across lines; several underlines at once.

items.name: Quote card
items.summary: Card rises with a soft shadow, an oversized quote mark drops in, text and attribution follow.

params.label: Quote
params.default: We cut our edit time in half the first week.

items.whenToUse: Testimonials, reviews, expert quotes, press mentions.
items.whenNotToUse: Quotes over about 20 words; fake or unattributed quotes.

items.name: Price strike
items.summary: Old price lands, a strike slashes it, the new price slams in, a discount badge spins on.
items.whenToUse: Offers, launches, comparison against a competitor price.
items.whenNotToUse: Prices that are not real or current (claims compliance); more than one offer per frame.

items.name: Notification toast
items.summary: Phone-style notification drops from the top with a spring, the icon pops, the body settles.
items.whenToUse: App demos, 'you got paid' or 'order shipped' beats, social proof, story setups.
items.whenNotToUse: Imitating a real app's exact notification design or brand; stacking more than three.
